Slot Definition: The cluster set to which this cluster belongs.

Subject: CellTypeTaxon
AIT Location: (derived: taxa at the levels above cluster_id in uns.hierarchy; read per row of uns.cluster_info)

Subject: CellTypeSet
Slot Definition: The next broader annotation level in the taxonomy hierarchy (e.g. Subclass has_parent Class).
AIT Location: (derived: the preceding level in uns.hierarchy, by order)

Subject: CellTypeTaxonomy
Slot Definition: The taxonomy for which this annotation level is defined.
AIT Location: (derived: the single taxonomy described by this file)

Subject: CellTypeTaxon
Slot Definition: Reference to the parent taxon at the next broader annotation level.
AIT Location: (derived: the taxon at the preceding uns.hierarchy level, same uns.cluster_info row)

Subject: CellTypeSet
Slot Definition: The annotation level (CellTypeSet) for which this taxon is a member.
AIT Location: (derived: the uns.hierarchy level whose uns.cluster_info column this taxon came from)

Subject: Cluster
Slot Definition: The cluster to which this cell has been assigned by the clustering algorithm.
Notes: Object reference for Cell.cluster_id string value

Subject: Embedding
Slot Definition: One or more dimensionality reductions associated with this taxonomy.
Notes: No BKE equivalent; AIT-specific analysis component

Subject: ExpressionMatrix
Slot Definition: One or more cell-by-gene matrices associated with this taxonomy (normalized and/or raw counts).
AIT Location: (derived: one ExpressionMatrix per X / raw.X group present)

Subject: GeneAnnotation
Slot Definition: One of the genes (variables) measured across all cells in this matrix; corresponds to a column in var.

Subject: GeneAnnotation
Slot Definition: Marker genes curated as characteristic of this cell type. One set per taxon; the AIT consensus taxonomy does not split these by species.
Notes: Replaces curated_markers_to_primates / curated_markers_to_mouse (BKE draft). The AIT files carry one species-independent column: verified identical across Human, Macaque and Marmoset for all 53 Groups present in all three. Group-level annotation, repeated on every cluster row.

Subject: CellTypeTaxon
Slot Definition: One of potentially many cell type terms which the abbreviation denotes.
